summary: Iteration 9 validates the new chat model switcher (GPT-5.4 default + Gemini 3.1 Pro + Gemini 3 Flash). Backend: 8/8 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_chat_models.py including REAL Gemini calls via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY: GET /api/chat/models (401 no auth; 200 with correct catalog shape {provider,model,name,vibe,description} x 3 and current defaulting to openai/gpt-5.4); POST /api/chat/model (401 no auth; 400 with 'Modelo no disponible.' for anthropic/claude-fable-5; 200 for gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview with Mongo users.chat_provider/chat_model persisted and reflected on subsequent GET); POST /api/chat/stream over Gemini flash — SSE emits event: user first, then event: start with elena message_id, >=1 event: delta with non-empty content, then event: done; regression stream test switching back to openai/gpt-5.4 also passes; POST /api/chat/message (non-stream) with Gemini-configured user returns {user_message, elena_message} with non-empty text. Total streaming completed <10s each in this run. Frontend (Playwright, seeded session cookie): /dashboard renders data-testid='chat-model-selector-trigger' in header; clicking opens data-testid='chat-model-selector-menu' with exactly 3 options — chat-model-selector-option-openai-gpt-5.4, chat-model-selector-option-gemini-gemini-3.1-pro-preview, chat-model-selector-option-gemini-gemini-3-flash-preview; clicking the flash option fires exactly 1 POST /api/chat/model with body {"provider":"gemini","model":"gemini-3-flash-preview"}, closes the menu, shows sonner toast containing 'Elena piensa ahora con Gemini · 3 Flash 💋', and the trigger label updates to 'Gemini · 3 Flash' (rendered as GEMINI · 3 FLASH due to uppercase tracking CSS). Regression selectors all present: voice-selector-trigger, voice-toggle-button, wa-call-button, chat-mic-button, chat-send-button, chat-clear-button. ambient-ensure fires once on mount. ElenaPlayer aspect ratio: desktop 1920px -> dashboard-player-container 1026.7w x 770.5h -> h/w=0.750 (16:12 ✓); mobile 390px -> 358w x 476.7h -> h/w=1.331 ≈ 4:3 (aspect-[3/4] ✓).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L88-123 CHAT_MODEL_CATALOG + _resolve_chat_model correctly validate provider/model against catalog and fall back to openai/gpt-5.4 for legacy users with no chat_provider set. Persistence in users doc is idempotent via $set.
server.py L418-436 /api/chat/models and /api/chat/model both properly gated by get_current_user; 400 with exact detail 'Modelo no disponible.' as spec.

server.py L301-306 and L365-370 both chat_message and chat_stream now use _resolve_chat_model(user) instead of hardcoded model — regression-safe: any user missing chat_provider gets DEFAULT_CHAT_PROVIDER='openai' / DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL='gpt-5.4'.

ChatModelSelector.jsx cleanly handles empty-catalog edge case (returns null if models.length===0), closes on outside click, disables trigger/options while saving, and re-uses toast+chatApi.setModel from lib/api.js. Good use of data-testid pattern chat-model-selector-option-<provider>-<model>.
Minor: /api/chat/model POST returns {provider, model} but frontend doesn't consume the response — it optimistically sets current from the request payload. Acceptable.
server.py stays at 1097 lines — earlier suggestion to split routers per feature remains but not blocking.
Consider adding user.chat_provider + user.chat_model to /api/auth/me response so Dashboard could pre-hydrate the selector without a second /api/chat/models fetch. Optimization, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (trigger + menu + 3 options + POST /api/chat/model + toast + label update + regressions)

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found.
